book.title: APOSOLO Aposolo Akali Tupamane Piape Peaini Tupa

content: Poloto Kiŋi Akitipana Wenonga Atoto, Pii Leane Oko

Pesatasato wuane lea-kola, kiŋi Akitipato Polo lamawuato, wamba Juta yame-mane nimbanga pii kenda-pene yata yaini tupa andipa nimba tane-mane yano peyo lola leaipia. Wuane lea-kola, Poloto balana kini aiyu loto, wua leaipia:

Kiŋi Akitipa nimbato nanima Juta yamena manapi, pii yanda piyamanepi, utupane pitaka wayumane wete andelene pia okoni. Tene okonena, namba nimbana wenonga atoto, pii kenda-pene Juta yame-mane nambanga yata apia tupa pitaka yano peyo lokale lo epele eyo. Nambato utupanena pii yano peyo pii lolowa-kola, nimbato wamba ini kepa naene, pii lolowa tupa ale aa gula leyo.

Wamba namba iwana patanenga, nambato Patasai yamena mana tupa wato minu atewa-kola, Juta yame-mane nambana mana minalawane tupa andeai. Patasai yame nanimato Gotena loo tupa kuai lo wete wato minu atoto, Juta yame wandakali waka tupa pitaka sia minalamane. Wamba nambana yuu tene okona atewa-angipi, matili namba Jutusaleme poto atewa-angipi, nambato Patasai yame okona mana epene utupane minu atewane okone Juta yame wandakali pitaka-mane nembo teyai. Tene okonena, utupane-mane nambana mana epene utupane nimba langimakale nembo teaindo, utupane-mane katulo langulu-peyai.

Wamba Goteto Juta yame alesa nanimana yumbane tupa ando potomisa pii mindi lamawuato, matili nambato wandakali omene tupa ika laya wakale leaipia. Wuane lea-kola, utulu otongapi, Juta yame wandakali utupane-mane Gote lo lotu loto, balato wandakali omene tupa ika laya yakale lo maliyo atalaini. Andipa nambatopi Goteto wandakali omene tupa ika laya yakale lo maliyo ateyo okonena, Juta yame wandakali utupane-mane nambanga pii kenda-pene yata wato, kosimi leyai.
Goteto wandakali omene tupa ika laya wakale lea-kola, anu peakale yakamana minditupa-mane pii okone bilipi nalape-pene nembo teyaipe.
Wamba nambato Nasatesa tane Jisasa okona gene oko minu koyoyale, mangene kambua pukale nembo tewa.

Wuane nembo tewa-kola, Poloto Kitisene wandakali tupa andi leakale leyama loto, pitisa akali kawane tupamane pepa mindi peyoto, namba geai. Geai-kola, nambato Kitisene kambua andi loto, katapusa andaka aindaka laka pua atewa. Dee, Pitisa akali kawane utupane-mane Kitisene wandakali utupane omeakale leai-angi, nambatopi enene utupane omeakale lewane teke. Nambato Jutusaleme atoto, mana utupane minu atewa.

Ole kambuanga namba Juta yamena lotu anda tupa pitakana kolandaka laka puato, kenda-pene andane tupa Kitisene wandakali peteaini tupanga maiki pewane. Nambato utupane lamawuato, yakamato Jisasa masia mawuato, bala ando pii koo lalapa lewane. Nambato Kitisene wandakali tupa ando yataka andane wete wato, tano amonga wete yane tupana poto, kenda-pene andane tupa utupane maiki pua, epoko pua atewane.
Polo Bala Kitisene Gulewane Lo Temane Leane Oko

Wuane lalu, Poloto pii minditupa tako pua kiŋi Akitipa lamawuato, wamba Pitisa akali kawane tupamane pepa mindi namba gipulu, Kitisene wandakali tupanga kenda-pene andane tupa malu puu leai-kola, namba Damasakasa tano okona poyale asini pewa leaipia.

Kiŋi nimbato nambana pii oko wayumane ale ape. Namba asini pewa-kola, otonga taeme tualo kilokopi mindi lea-angi, nambato andewa-kola, tii-pene andane wete nai ita minene mindi ati kenga ato epoto, nambapi, akali namba towa atu pemane tupapi, nanimanga tii pikoyo pea.

Tii pikoyo pea-kola, nanima pitaka yuunga lomba-pene yo atema. Namba lomba-pene yoto ale ewa-kola, pii mindi leane okomane Iputu pii loto, Solo, Solo, nimbana masianesa minditaka mindi ateya-kola, nimbato okone wato apokale nembo toto, nimbana kee masianesa piande-piande peya aiyu lele. Wuane pele-kola, yandate nembo atene mindimane nimbana kene yandate eya-kola, nimba tane tandaka nele-ko. Anu peakale nimbato kenda-pene andane tupa namba giki pilinipe lea.
Wuane lea-kola, nambato Akali Andane, nimba apipe lewa. Wuane lewa-kola, Akali Andane okomane namba akali Jisasa nimbato kenda-pene andane tupa giki pua atele okone lea.

Wamba nimbato kenda-pene andane tupa namba giki pilini tekeko, andipa nimba nambana piape akali atola lolo epeyo-ko. Nimba ika lo ata. Nambato minditaka andipa peyo-kola, andele tupapi, nambato minditaka matili nimba andawa lolowa-kola, andolopele tupapi, utupane pitaka nimbato wandakali tupa lamawua atola lolo epeyo.

Nimbato nambana pii oko utupane lamaule-kola, utupane-mane namba lo bilipi lolopeyai nembo teyo. Bilipi lolai-kola, nambato utupanena mana koo minalaini tupa apia-mawuato, utupane nambato wamba mo kuai laya ewane wandakali tupa towa atu nambana yame ateakale lolo-peyawa. Nambato wuane pukale nembo toto, wandakali undupi pangosa ateyai utupane-mane Satanena tai-lene oko tepa alu, Gotena tii-pene okona epoto, bala wato miniakale loto, nimbato utupanena lene tupa mo tii piya olo puu leyo. Nimbato piape okone pua atole-kola, Juta yame wandakali tupapi, wandakali yame waka tupapi, utupane-mane nimba minu koyoyale pulai-angi, utupanena kininga nambato nimba molo-peke lolo-peyawa. Akali Andane okomane wuane loto, namba langea. Poloto wuane leaipia.
Poloto Piape Peane Tupa Akitipa Lamaiyane Oko

Wuane lalu, Poloto pii minditupa tako pua loto, kiŋi Akitipa nimbato wayumane ale ape leaipia. Tii pene wetete mindi ati kenga atoto, nanimanga tii pikoyo peane okone andoto, pii mindi leane okone ale wato, nambato tanga nalewane. Jia.

Tanga nalene, wamba ini bulupane nambato Gotena pii oko Damasakasa tane wandakali tupa lamalu pewa. Poto, yakamato yamapane peke loto, Gote bilipi loto, mana epene minulai tupamane yakamana yamapane peke laima lo andawa lalapape lewa. Wuane lalu, matili namba Jutusalemepi, Jutiya disitiki yuu waka tupapi, utupane pitakana poto, Juta yamepi, wandakali yame waka tupapi, utupane pitaka pii mindiki okone teke lamaewa.
Nambato pii okonepene tupa lamaima epoko pua atalawane okonena, Juta yame akali tupamane yataka wato, lotu anda andane okona epoto, namba minuto, peyo ome loyale peai.

Utupane-mane wuane peaini tekeko, wamba Mosesapi, potopesa akali tupapi, utupane-mane wandakali tupa lamawuato, matili Mesaya oko bala tandaka nalu, omalu, wamba ini bulupane malinga ika lolopeya. Ika lalu, balato Gotena pii oko Juta yamepi, wandakali yame waka tupapi, utupane lamawuato, Goteto yakamana nembo-tene tupa mo tii piya eya lolopeya leainipia. Wuane leai-kola, Goteto namba moyama teke ipulu, andipa ateyama gii okona giau leya. Tene okonena, andipa namba balana wisanisa atoto, pii waka mindi nalene, pii wamba potopesa akali tupamane leaini okone teke wandakali gene yenepi, nayenepi, yakama pitaka langeyo leaipia.
Poloto wuane lo pii yano peyo atea-kola, Pesatasato pii taimane wete loto, Polo, nimba mana kambua wete meene okonemane nimba minu kee eya okonena, nimbato kee wato pii okone lele leaipia.
Wuane lea-kola, Poloto bala lamawuato, akali andane Pesatasa, namba akali kee ene, jia leaipia. Namba mini paluto, enene pii utupane leyo.

Kataisa bala mindisa too pua ata napene, ama tombenenga atoto, nambato leyo pua peane. Wandakali-mane Kataisa balato wuane peane leai-kola, Kiŋi Akitipato pii okone wamba ale ya okoni. Tene okonena, nambato yuku naene, Kataisa balato wuane peane lo bala lamaiyo.

Wamba potopesa akali tupamane loto, matili Mesaya okomane wuane pulupeya leainipia. Kiŋi Akitipa nimbato potopesa akali utupanena pii okone enene ya lo bilipi lelepe. Potopesa akali utupane-mane pii leaini okone enene ya lo nimbato bilipi lele lo nambato nembo teyo leaipia.
Poloto wuane lea-kola, Kiŋi Akitipato bala tipa puato, gii ukupini oko angi teke, nimbato katulo namba mo Kitisene gulaya wakale nembo toto, wuane lelepe leaipia.

Kiŋi Akitipato wuane lea-kola, Poloto balana pii okone yano peyoto, gii ukupini oko angi teke yandopi, gii luu mindi pola-kola yandopi, nimbapi, wandakali nimba towa atu nambana pii leyo tupa alewa peteyai tupapi, yakama pitaka Kitisene namba ateyo okopene teke gulalapale loto, nambato Gote lo pote leyo. Wuane tekeko, sene ende nambanga eya tupa yakamanga yakale lo nambato pote naleyo leaipia.
Poloto wuane lea-kola, kiŋi Akitipa okopi, bala imalini Benisa okopi, gapomane akali kawane Pesatasa okopi, dee wandakali utupane towa atu peteaini tupapi, utupane pitaka ika lalu, kamaka peainipia.

Kamaka pulu, utupane-mane yakama tane teke-teke pii lalawa piki puato, akali okomane mana koo mindi mina napea-kola, nanimato bala katapusa pale lape-penepi, peyo ome lape-penepi, tene mindi ata napeya leainipia.

Wuane loto, wandakali utupane-mane Kiŋi Akitipato Pesatasa lamawuato, akali okonemane Lomo tane gapomane akali kawane Sisato balana kote oko ale yakale nalapia-yale, nimbato katulo bala peakale tepa api-yale leainipia.
